# Regional daily study (generated by `scripts/run_daily_regional_study.py`)

Git commit `59793d2a7c`. Zenodo state-level daily energy met (MU); validation 2021-2022; test 2023-01-01 to 2024-04-28 (single run). Target in every model: ratio to the same-weekday anchor. MAE in MU, MAPE and WAPE in %. Paired intervals: 95% moving-block bootstrap, block 28 days.

## Horizon 1 day

Samples: train 2,119, validation 603, test 473. Direct XGBoost best of 20 trials (validation MAE 49.7 MU); ridge alpha 0.1.

| Validation model | MAE (MU) | MAPE % | WAPE % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| naive | 141.1 | 3.63 | 3.59 |
| ridge | 52.1 | 1.35 | 1.33 |
| xgb_direct | 49.9 | 1.29 | 1.27 |
| xgb_bottom_up | 45.3 | 1.17 | 1.15 |

| TEST model | MAE (MU) | MAPE % | WAPE % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| naive | 182.4 | 4.22 | 4.15 |
| ridge | 58.1 | 1.34 | 1.32 |
| xgb_direct | 61.0 | 1.42 | 1.39 |
| xgb_bottom_up | 72.0 | 1.65 | 1.64 |

Paired differences on the test period (MAE of first minus second, MU; negative = first better):

| first | second | difference | 95% CI |
|---|---|---:|---|
| xgb_bottom_up | xgb_direct | +11.1 | +1.9 to +17.9 |
| xgb_direct | ridge | +2.8 | -3.3 to +10.3 |
| xgb_direct | naive | -121.4 | -156.0 to -96.3 |
| xgb_bottom_up | naive | -110.3 | -150.9 to -78.4 |

Regional test MAE (MU) of the XGBoost regional model / naive anchor: Northern: 28.2 / 87.3; Western: 20.1 / 66.5; Southern: 17.5 / 56.0; Eastern: 10.0 / 30.4; North-Eastern: 1.5 / 3.5

|---|---:|---:|---:|
| naive | 140.3 | 3.60 | 3.56 |
| ridge | 136.1 | 3.49 | 3.45 |

| first | second | difference | 95% CI |
|---|---|---:|---|
| xgb_bottom_up | xgb_direct | +4.1 | -12.0 to +14.7 |
| xgb_direct | ridge | -0.7 | -10.0 to +11.5 |
| xgb_direct | naive | -17.1 | -31.9 to -2.3 |
| xgb_bottom_up | naive | -13.0 | -32.5 to +5.1 |

Regional test MAE (MU) of the XGBoost regional model / naive anchor: Northern: 73.3 / 86.5; Western: 60.1 / 66.1; Southern: 50.2 / 56.1; Eastern: 25.2 / 30.2; North-Eastern: 2.9 / 3.5
